publicRights.note: MIT and provenance records are present; independent rights review is pending.

bankIntegrity.note: The fixed public bank and sealed file bindings pass mechanical validation.

humanCriterion.note: No independent blinded human labels have been collected.

judgeQualification.note: No human-referenced qualification report exists; the host-held transport probe obtained structured votes from Terra, Luna, and Sol, but the models disagreed (Sol/Terra left; Luna right), so the probe remains unqualified and unmeasured.

reliability.note: Inter-annotator and judge reliability studies have not been run.

contamination.note: Mechanical public-exposure and overlap records exist; training inclusion and independent semantic review remain unknown.

execution.note: Two isolated Harbor Oracle controls and four isolated Codex candidate trials exist for one selected case; complete release/form coverage is pending.

validity.note: The validity argument is prospective; no activation evidence supports an active benchmark claim.
